notes: Kakao's first self-built hyperscale data center, located inside Hanyang University's ERICA campus in Ansan-si (Sangnok-gu); construction began 2021 and operations started around Q1 2024. Facility is about 47,378 sqm with 4,000 racks designed to host 120,000 servers; Kakao's CEO visited in December 2024 to review operations. No public MW figure found in sources reviewed.
